blocks.text: The following example shows how to retrieve your EASM organizations using GET /organizations:

blocks.item: In the workspace where you added your collection, go to Collections.
Click the OneAPI folder and then click the External Attack Surface Management (EASM) folder.
Go to Organizations > GET Organizations. The /organizations request appears on the right-side pane.

blocks.text: When the request is successful, you receive a Status 200 OK message and a response body.
